Body is two fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash calls (2nd via the transparent thunk it tail-JMPs into) at tiles (3,0x1B)/id 1 and (0xF,0x1B)/id 2 -- a 2-portrait white-flash cutscene reveal with no dialog and no combat_aux_block AI-flag writes. AI-control handlers in this same file call fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range (e.g. handler_30/3b/3c); this one does not. The dispatch index '3f' (per-event handler-table idx 0x3F, verified: (0x51c8d-0x51b91)/4 = 0x3F) and chapter 'ch27' are meaningful domain IDs and must be kept. The descriptor must change to 'cinematic' to match sibling cinematic handlers fd2_chapter_event_handler_36__ch24_cinematic and fd2_chapter_event_handler_39__ch26_cinematic. No address residue in the name. Recorded only; Stage 2 applies (touches protos.h, the dispatch-table @ 0x51C8D reference, the handler-table emit, and the wrap-thunk's '1 caller' plate cross-reference).
purpose: Chapter 27 per-event handler (dispatch idx 0x3F), turn-event slot 0 at the turn=0xFF sentinel marker: plays a 2-portrait white-flash cinematic reveal. No AI control, no dialog.
logic_summary: Stack-frame __CHK(0x10). Calls fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash(3, 0x1B, 1) for the first portrait reveal at tile (3,0x1B) with portrait-group id 1, then issues the second reveal at tile (0xF,0x1B) with id 2 via fd2_wrap_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash(0xF, 0x1B, 2). In the binary the second reveal is reached by pushing its 3 args and tail-JMPing into the wrap thunk @ 0x35318 so the handler borrows that thunk's 0xC-byte cleanup tail; the thunk forwards straight to the cinematic helper @ 0x35822 (pan -> portrait swap -> white palette flash -> composite -> 400ms hold). The dispatch ABI passes 1 arg (event_arg) which this handler does not read; the decompiler's in_stack_00000000 / in_stack_00000008 are tail-call stack residue, not real reads.
